name: ToDos Board
description: Personal to-dos with custom states, tags, priorities, markdown notes, list and board views, and coding agents you start from a to-do.

settings.title: Archive closed to-dos
settings.description: Move a to-do to the archive this many days after it was closed. Archived to-dos stay searchable under Archived, and you can restore them.

settings.title: Due date reminders
settings.description: Show a notification when an open to-do comes due.

settings.title: Reminder time for all-day to-dos
settings.description: When to remind about a to-do due on a day with no time set. To-dos with a time are reminded at that time.
